plugin.notes: 2.6.0 follows Orca's plugin guide: the plugin no longer updates itself. Update it from Orca (Settings → Plugins → Update); listed copies update automatically. Also checks for an OS key store before setup.

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
